column1: #mapping_set_description: STAC (PDSSP profile) fields to EPN-TAP 2.0 columns. The 'other' column names the transform the converter applies.

column8: One granule per observation today; revisit when several levels of one observation are catalogued.
ssys values are EPN target-class term ids; checked against the PADC vocabulary.
Body frame: planetocentric east longitude in 0-360.
DALI polygon, east longitudes; check with STILTS taplint.
A projected planetary footprint is body-fixed; no projection means no footprint.
No EPNcore column for the mission: instrument_host_name carries the platform.
An IAU planetary CRS is body-fixed.
PDSSP Raw is CODMAC Edited (2): close, not exact.
STAC created is the metadata record date.
No release date in STAC: public as soon as catalogued.
No EPNcore column for the acquisition technique: lost on export.
Band names have no EPNcore column; spectral_range_* is to be computed from eo:center_wavelength and eo:full_width_half_max (not done yet).
No EPNcore column for the spectral domain; spectral_range_* carries the numbers.
No EPNcore column for the product version: lost on export.
